 """Small text helpers for URL slugs."""
 
+import re
+
+_SEPARATORS = re.compile(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+")
+
 
 def slugify(text):
     """Normalize text to an ASCII URL slug."""
-    return text
+    if not isinstance(text, str):
+        raise TypeError(f"slugify() expects str, got {type(text).__name__}")
+    # Replace before lowercasing so only ASCII letters reach str.lower();
+    # some non-ASCII characters (e.g. KELVIN SIGN) lowercase to ASCII.
+    return _SEPARATORS.sub("-", text).strip("-").lower()

+import pytest
+
+from slugtools import slugify
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("text", "expected"),
+    [
+        ("Hello World", "hello-world"),
+        ("  --Hello,   World!--  ", "hello-world"),
+        ("Already-A-Slug-42", "already-a-slug-42"),
+        ("a__b..c", "a-b-c"),
+        ("Café Ünïcode", "caf-n-code"),
+        ("K", ""),
+        ("x٣y", "x-y"),
+        ("", ""),
+        ("-_ !?-", ""),
+    ],
+)
+def test_slugify(text, expected):
+    assert slugify(text) == expected
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("value", [None, 42, b"bytes", ["a"]])
+def test_slugify_rejects_non_strings(value):
+    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
+        slugify(value)
